channel.title: HomerScribe Walkthroughs
channel.description: Short simulated walks through HomerScribe. Each one is a real job done from start to finish, about three minutes, with something to try at the end.
channel.itunes:author: Jamal Mazrui

item.title: 0 - Overview
item.description: Nothing yet. This one is two minutes of what to expect. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0-0-overview

item.title: 1 - User Interface
item.description: HomerScribe is installed. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0a-1-user-interface

item.title: 2 - Install and Launch
item.description: HomerScribe_setup.exe is downloaded from the HomerScribe page on GitHub. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0b-2-install-and-launch

item.title: 3 - Transcribe a Recording
item.description: A recording named Introduction_to_Windows.mp3 is in the Videos folder. HomerScribe is installed. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0c-3-transcribe-a-recording

item.title: 4 - Describe a Video
item.description: HomerScribe is installed, with Ollama and its picture model. The dialog still holds the sample address. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0d-4-describe-a-video

item.title: 5 - A Web Address, Sound Only
item.description: HomerScribe is installed, with Ollama. A YouTube address is on the clipboard. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0e-5-a-web-address-sound-only

item.title: 6 - Remove the Advertisements
item.description: HomerScribe is installed, with Ollama and its reading model. An episode named Episode_212.mp3 is in the Videos folder. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0f-6-remove-the-advertisements

item.title: 7 - Read a PDF
item.description: HomerScribe is installed, with Ollama, Tesseract and Pandoc. A file named Annual_Report.pdf is in the Videos folder. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0g-7-read-a-pdf

item.title: 8 - Stay Current
item.description: HomerScribe is installed and its dialog is open. The computer is online. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0h-8-stay-current

item.title: 9 - Conclusion
item.description: Nothing is needed; this walk is listened to. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0i-9-conclusion
